hints.title: Bowl Geometry Definition
hints.text: A valid bowl subarray of length at least 3 has interior values strictly less than both boundary endpoints.

hints.title: Boundary Dominance Condition
hints.text: Check if every value between index l and index r falls below min(nums[l], nums[r]).

hints.title: Subarray Traversal
hints.text: Iterate across all endpoint pairs (l, r) separated by at least one internal cell.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct range verification over endpoint pairs for small inputs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining non-contiguous subsets is invalid for contiguous subarray problems.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Verifies ranges in place with zero auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce strict inequality on interior values relative to min(left, right).
